newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU declines comment on Anglo/Lonrho report.
newsitem.headline: EU declines comment on Anglo/Lonrho report.

text.p: The European Commission declined comment on Wednesday on a report that European Union investigators had recommended banning Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd from keeping a 28 percent stake in Lonrho Plc.

The Wall Street Journal reported that Commission competition officials had moved to deny regulatory approval of the acquisition by the South African mining giant, a decision that had been backed by an advisory committee of national officials.
A spokesman for Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said he had no comment on the report.
The Journal said the Commission, which has until May 5 to make a final decision, is expected to follow the preliminary rulings.

Anglo American increased its Lonrho shareholding to 28.4 percent from 10 percent in November, despite Van Miert's warnings that it should not try to take control of Lonrho's platinum interests based in South Africa. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
